web_title: Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg – Calm Evenings Support
web_description_html:
Meet Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg, a gentle, chelated magnesium formula designed for busy parents who want to support their body's natural evening wind-down. Each vegetable capsule delivers 200 mg of magnesium bisglycinate, a highly tolerable form chosen for digestive comfort.

  • Helps to maintain proper muscle function, including the heart muscle.
  • Helps in the development and maintenance of bones and teeth.
  • Helps to prevent magnesium deficiency.
  • Helps in energy metabolism and in tissue formation.

Serving size: 1 capsule, 1 to 2 times daily.
Form: Vegetable capsule.
Attributes: Vegan, gluten free, non-GMO.
NPN 80098765

Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Some people may experience diarrhoea.
